terms.definition: A new substance created by a chemical reaction.
terms.function: Shows up on the right of the equation as the reaction's outcome.
terms.whereItIs: The water molecule on the right of the equation.
terms.whyItMatters: Products are the results of every chemical change.

terms.definition: A shorthand description of a reaction with products on the right.
terms.function: Shows what is produced at a glance.
terms.whereItIs: The whole scene in the model.
terms.whyItMatters: Equations are how chemists read and share reactions.

terms.definition: The rule that the mass of products equals the mass of reactants.
terms.function: Guarantees atoms are neither created nor destroyed.
terms.whereItIs: Reflected by the product's atoms matching the reactants' atoms.
terms.whyItMatters: Conservation of mass is a fundamental law of chemistry.
